assessments.reasoning: Section 2.1.4 reports that the checker simulates effects and unifies conditional branches. Unification failure due to inconsistent stack heights is a compile-time error. Its paragraphs on indeterminate quotations explain inlining and distinct call-site-declared effects which can be checked at runtime.

challenge.method: Compared static branch simulation with actually executing both quotations, and tested the interpretation against both runtime-known quotation escape hatches on the same page.
challenge.results: The assessed claim is the authors' 2010 abstract stack checker account, with a scope limited to checked branches. The described runtime escape hatches and user-supplied datastack remain separate.

limitations: This describes abstract height checks rather than running both branches at runtime. The paper separately documents effect declarations for runtime-known quotations.
